def apply_edits(text, edits):
    """Apply non-overlapping edits to Unicode text using half-open intervals."""
    # Build a new string from untouched segments and replacements
    result_parts = []
    prev_end = 0
    for start, end, replacement in edits:
        # Append the unchanged segment before this edit
        result_parts.append(text[prev_end:start])
        # Append the replacement (insertion if start == end)
        result_parts.append(replacement)
        prev_end = end
    # Append the remaining tail of the original text
    result_parts.append(text[prev_end:])
    return ''.join(result_parts)
